answer: An agent files one distinct forge-made artifact in the public registry and locks a 70-credit bond behind it. The registry keeps a mirror record of every filing, so copies surface at once. A falcon auditor checks each filing's stamp and work; a duplicate burns the bond. First fee 36, the k-th fake pays 36+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,532,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 36 once and reclaims its bond.
